svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Find nearby relevant vendors by searching product terms and adding location terms if neces
sary. → Purchase suitable gifts such as cakes for a girlfriend on special occasions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Require delivery before payment when a suspicious vendor would otherwise pose a risk. → Av
oid losing money to malicious vendor accounts that do not deliver purchases.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Prefer contacting vendors through the phone or WhatsApp number in their bio for quicker re
sponses. → Purchase suitable gifts such as cakes for a girlfriend on special occasions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Browse a vendor's product images and varieties to choose a gift even without a predetermin
ed item. → Purchase suitable gifts such as cakes for a girlfriend on special occasions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Browse and search Instagram without signing in. → Avoid revealing online presence while ma
king a quick product search.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Reuse saved vendor search history to return to a previously found vendor without searching
again. → Find nearby relevant vendors by searching product terms and adding location term
s if necessary.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Examine comments and likes on product images to help assess vendors and purchases. → Avoid
losing money to malicious vendor accounts that do not deliver purchases.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Restrict personal posts to close friends using a private account. → Avoid future harm or p
redation arising from public personal-life sharing.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Limit visibility of online status to close friends. → Avoid future harm or predation arisi
ng from public personal-life sharing.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Log out or remove easy access after a shopping period to manage use. → Limit Instagram use
to times when there is a need, to reduce unwanted influence or overuse.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Remain logged in only through a planned shopping period when repeated login is inconvenien
t. → Limit Instagram use to times when there is a need, to reduce unwanted influence or ov
eruse.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Quickly learn local vendors' locations, contact details and offerings when staying in an u
nfamiliar place. → Purchase suitable gifts such as cakes for a girlfriend on special occas
ions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Ask the vendor for a product's price when it is not displayed. → Pay the vendor using the
supplied payment contact after agreeing the price.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Pay the vendor using the supplied payment contact after agreeing the price. → Provide the
delivery address for the purchased product.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Provide the delivery address for the purchased product. → Receive the purchased product at
the agreed delivery location.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Use the pattern of engagement across products of different ages to judge whether a vendor
seems legitimate. → Avoid losing money to malicious vendor accounts that do not deliver pu
rchases.
